findings.finding: The video overlay reports fan voltage and an air-velocity transducer reading in cm/s. Fan voltage is calibrated against airspeed at the end of operations days.
The report describes daily oxygen-sensor offset correction using the Major Constituents Analyzer and a CO sensor range of 0-1000 ppm.
findings.scope: Sensor interpretation; no numerical substitute for ambiguous CSV codes is supplied here.

findings.finding: The air-velocity probe has an approximately one-minute response time and a reported effective display resolution of +/-0.5 cm/s. Calibration depends on the restrictor configuration.
findings.scope: Hardware discussion for concurrent PMMA rod tests

findings.finding: For the SIBAL fabric experiments, Table 7.1 lists starting and final velocities when flow changes. The time and rate of change vary between tests.
findings.scope: SIBAL fabric tests; endpoints are not a full time series.

findings.finding: Table 7.1 contains 27 BASS-II fabric tests and four separate BASS tests. Its footnote flags the oxygen readings of GMT45-T1 and GMT45-T2 as potentially inaccurate.
Section 7.1.4 reports slower steady spread for narrower SIBAL samples, lower flow velocities, and lower oxygen percentages within the studied cases.
findings.scope: Study-specific qualitative trend; this package does not digitize Figure 7.4 spread rates or extrapolate to other materials or gravity levels.
